items.label: Ableprint Technology press release: Investor Conference Presentation (English), Aug 2026 (08-27-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Company calls itself a 'Global Leader in De-void Solutions'

set.signal: Company calls itself a 'Global Leader in De-void Solutions' and 'Process Systems & PlatForms Integrator' addressing four packaging challenges (residue, warpage, metal joint, heat dissipation). Product milestones: 1st Gen Void-Free, 2nd Gen model for WLP, PLP and FCBGA, 3rd Gen model for RDL and bumping, 4th Gen LEAPSolve platform, plus WSAS-C / WSAS-V warpage suppression and WGBA (Warpage Gang Bond Annealing); products named VFS, VTS Pioneer, PRO and EvoRTS. On its 'oS' process-flow slide the company says '3 steps can be removed!' with EvoRTS (company claim); a slide headed 'CPO CoPoS/CoWoP/CoS Blooming Application' also shows EvoRTS and WSAS

items.reason: The deck does not map VFS to the 1st generation or call the flow 'chip-on-substrate' (it prints 'oS Process Flow'); the EvoRTS/WSAS link to CPO / CoPoS is slide co-location only. Rewritten to what the slides print.
items.evidence: oS Process Flow ... 3 steps can be removed! ... With EvoRTS SKIP ... CPO CoPoS/CoWoP/CoS Blooming Application ... EvoRTS WSAS
